 The Golden State Warriors welcome the Los Angeles Clippers to Chase Center on Sunday night for a Pacific Division showdown, with the two teams heading in opposite directions early in the 2026-27 NBA season.
 Apr 15, 2026; Inglewood, California, USA; Los Angeles Clippers guard Darius Garland (10) drives to the basket past Golden State Warriors guard Stephen Curry (30) in the first half during the play-in rounds of the 2026 NBA Playoffs at Intuit Dome. Mandatory Credit: Jayne Kamin-Oncea-Imagn Images
 How to Watch Clippers vs Warriors
 When: Friday, October 30, 2026
 Time: 8:30 PM ET
 TV Channel: NBC Sports Bay Area, ClipperVision
 Live Stream: Fubo ( try for free )
 Golden State enters the matchup with a 3-3 record after winning three consecutive games, including an impressive 112-95 victory over the Los Angeles Lakers on Friday night. Stephen Curry has been outstanding during the winning streak, scoring 44 points against Minnesota before dropping 31 against the Lakers. Brandin Podziemski added 21 points in Friday’s victory, while Draymond Green continues to provide veteran leadership and playmaking. Despite playing without injured stars Jimmy Butler and Kristaps Porzingis, the Warriors have found their rhythm offensively and will look to extend their winning streak to four games.
 The Clippers have struggled to begin the season, dropping four consecutive games after winning their opener against Sacramento. Los Angeles enters Sunday’s contest at 1-4 following a disappointing 127-101 loss to the Minnesota Timberwolves on Friday night. Darius Garland has been a bright spot for the Clippers, averaging more than 20 points per game, but injuries to Brandon Ingram and Bradley Beal have limited the team’s offensive options. Los Angeles will need a strong performance from Garland and its supporting cast to slow down Curry and the surging Warriors. The teams tip off Sunday at 8:30 p.m. ET.
